title: Missing-field validation returns 422, not 400
evidence: src/api.c:37 reply_validation sets res->status=422; REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify expects rejected (400). Malformed JSON does return 400 (src/api.c:161).
suggestion: Acceptable per REST semantics (422 Unprocessable Entity), but note the spec example says 400; return 400 if strict conformance is required.

title: Health check verifies the database, not just liveness
evidence: src/api.c:89 db_count() gates /health; returns 503 with {"status":"error","database":"unavailable"} on failure.

title: Integration tests exercise the real binary over TCP incl. restart durability
evidence: tests/test_api.c launches build/bookapi on an ephemeral port; README reports 276 checks across 3 suites; test_restart_persistence proves durability.
